name: color-picker
title: Color Picker
blurb: Popover color picker with HSL/Hex input, saturation-lightness canvas, hue…
description: Controlled input component with hex/HSL conversion, 2D saturation-lightness picker (gradient canvas with crosshair), hue range slider (rainbow gradient), text input, and 12 color presets. Framer Motion animations on open/close and hover.
use_when: Design tools, theme customizers, or any form needing color input without relying on native pickers.
avoid_when: Mobile (native pickers are better). No keyboard-only color selection.
a11y: Color input label is screen-reader only. Canvas picker requires mouse. Presets are buttons but no aria-label.
